metadata.boundary: Executes the official TypeScript src/main.ts after matching every tracked worktree blob to the pinned commit, through the caller-installed frozen-lockfile tsx dependency. Kimi owns its prompts, v2 Agent and AgentSwarm tools, permission policy, compaction, subagent scheduling, and workspace tools; ignored and generated dependency content remains outside the attestation.
metadata.accounting: The public stream-json protocol does not emit whole-tree token or cost totals, so usage is explicitly unknown and incomplete.
metadata.prompt_transport: The official non-interactive interface accepts the task through --prompt, so local process inspection can observe prompt text during the run.
metadata.workspace_owner: Kimi Code owns a caller-supplied disposable single-trial worktree; do not add a local environment block.
